Prompt.masterLabel: Linear Form Templates and UG Link for Branching

promptVersions.body:
You're ready to start building your Form Template. Let's go!

Make sure you've got a list handy of the things you'd like to say. Once that's in place, let's start building out your script. In this example, we'll build a linear survey (the same questions are sent, no matter the response of the recipient). These are the outbound texts that Mogli will send your recipient.


  1. In the Question Templates section, click New
  2. Name the question (we recommend starting it with "1.0...", select the associated Form Template, and enter your Message Text. Check the First Question checkbox. Click Save & New
  3. Repeat for your second question. If you still have more questions, leave the First Question and Form Complete checkboxes blank. Click Save & New
  4. When you've reached a your last (or potentially last) question, check the Form Complete checkbox and Save
  5. In the Question Template section, click View All, which brings you to your list of questions
  6. Click on the name of your first question
  7. In the Default Next Question lookup field, select the question that should come after your first question. Then, copy the Message Text of your first question because we’ll need this later. Click Save
  8. Click on the name of your second question and select the question that should come after your second question.
  9. Repeat as needed
  10. For your last question, leave the Default Next Question lookup field blank, as there are no further questions.
  11. Click on the name of your Form Template
  12. Click on View All in the Question Template section
  13. Notice your populated Default Next Questions. These show the order in which the questions will be sent. Ensure that your First Question has the checkbox checked and that your last question has the Form Complete checkbox checked
  14. Revisit the previous screen and set your Form Template's Status to Active. If you would like recipients to text in to start this survey, enter a value in the Query String field. This acts as an inbound keyword. Click Save
  15. Right-click on the SMS Templates tab and open it in a new tab
  16. Click New
  17. Name the SMS Template accordingly and paste the Message Text from your first question into the Text field. It must match exactly. Attach the associated Form Template in the Form Template lookup field. Click Save
  18. Navigate to your test Contact or Lead record and select your SMS Template from the drop-down menu. Test it out!
  19. After you finish, visit the Forms tab where you'll be able to see the questions you received and how you responded. You should see that your Form has a Status of Complete. Had you not made it through to a question you'd marked as Form Complete, the Status would be Active. You'll also find your responses anywhere the Forms related list is added, such as on the Form Template record, and within Contact and Lead related lists


Branching surveys are a bit different. Similar to linear surveys, they'll contain only one First Question, but may contain multiple possible Form Complete questions. The other pieces to configure in branching surveys are:


Possible Answers - if you've asked for a YES or NO response, you can designate what constitutes as those responses here, such as: yes:::yep:::yeah:::👍 (yes- you can use emojis!) Then, map to the next question.

Default Next Question - With a branching survey, this is the question the recipient receives if they DO NOT respond with one of your designated Possible Answers. This is a way to get them back on track.
